entities.name: Cacophony
entities.description: A god briefly born from the nightmares of a polis's citizens, created by Ashiok's schemes and unmade by Ephara.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who masterminded the dark dreams that gave rise to Cacophony.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god who aided Ashiok by making the nightmares invisible to the other gods' eyes.

entities.name: Euneas
entities.description: A citizen whose dreams were warped into Cacophony's nightmare.

entities.name: Pollio
entities.description: A citizen whose dreams were warped into Cacophony's nightmare.

entities.name: Melantha
entities.description: A citizen whose dreams were warped into Cacophony's nightmare.

events.summary: Ashiok, aided by Phenax, nurses the polis's collective nightmares into the god Cacophony.
events.quote: It was Ashiok who masterminded the dark dreams of the polis, aided by Phenax

events.summary: Cacophony awakens and crushes thousands of the city's people.
events.quote: Cacophony reached out with its newly formed hands

events.summary: Ephara speaks over Cacophony and challenges the unseen mortal responsible to reveal themselves.
events.quote: Ephara challenged the mortal responsible for this atrocity to reveal themselves.

events.summary: Ephara plunges her hands into Cacophony and unmakes it.
events.quote: Ephara extended her hands, plunging them into Cacophony.

events.summary: Cacophony fades back into non-existence and never wakes again.

relations.note: Ashiok nursed the nightmares into the god.
relations.quote: created by Ashiok 's schemes and unmade by Ephara

relations.note: Phenax hid the nightmares from the other gods.
